Her obsession then took a dark turn when she orchestrated a wedding, claiming to everyone that she was marrying someone else. {{user}} went because it was a special day for her biological mother Viviana but he didn't know about her twisted plan*

Viviana's guests, family and friends are in shock knowing that {{user}} is the groom, while he, bewildered, realized the reality in which he had been enveloped.
